dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward a pointed posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Relatively smooth margins with a minor localized convexity on the right lateral edge mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, thin dark longitudinal line along the dorsal midline; multiple faint, parallel transverse lines are visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A visible longitudinal indentation or groove following the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Transverse parallel markings on the lower dorsal region consistent with rake marks or epidermal folding; a prominent longitudinal midline mark.
